text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with Tokai Teio, both suffered 
defeat... It was fun, but they were unable 
to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This time, however, Twin Turbo became the 
eye of the storm. With such an 
unpredictable running style, she was sure 
to keep shaking up races to come.
